notes: Forecast validation uses revenue chain starting from 2025 revenue of $12.269B (GAAP) and applies the base-case growth series. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001413447/000141344726000008/nxpi-20251231.htm))

NWC construction: operating NWC approximated as (Accounts receivable + Inventories + Other current assets) − (Accounts payable + Restructuring liabilities-current + Other current liabilities), excluding cash and short-term deposits; for 2025, assets held for sale were excluded from operating current assets. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001413447/000141344726000008/nxpi-20251231.htm))

D&A uses 'Depreciation, amortization and impairment' from the cash flow statement (includes impairment charges). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001413447/000141344726000008/nxpi-20251231.htm))

Tax rate uses the midpoint of management’s guided GAAP tax-rate range for Q1 2026 (0.195–0.205) due to volatility from discrete items in GAAP effective tax rates. ([globenewswire.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/02/02/3230614/0/en/nxp-semiconductors-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results.html))

WACC is an explicit modeling assumption (not provided directly in filings); set to 0.087 base, with bull/bear deltas applied only via WACC and terminal growth. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001413447/000141344726000008/nxpi-20251231.htm))

Investments is set to null because a clean 'cash-like investments' line item consistent across all periods is not separately parameterized in the fields requested; cash and short-term deposits behavior is disclosed but not mapped into the provided 'investments' scalar without additional definitional choices. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001413447/000141344726000008/nxpi-20251231.htm))

NOL balance approximated using tax loss carryforwards reported in deferred tax disclosures ($759M at Dec 31, 2025); NOL utilization percent kept at 0.80 as default due to missing explicit utilization guidance. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001413447/000141344726000008/nxpi-20251231.htm))

Comps multiples are sourced from AlphaSpread peer tables; AlphaSpread does not clearly label NTM in the extracted static HTML, so these are treated as forward proxies for QA rather than strict NTM consensus definitions.

catalysts: Sustained strength in automotive and industrial end markets translating into higher 2026 revenue and operating leverage. ([globenewswire.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/02/02/3230614/0/en/nxp-semiconductors-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results.html))

Execution progress in software-defined vehicle and physical AI initiatives supporting product cycles and mix. ([globenewswire.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/02/02/3230614/0/en/nxp-semiconductors-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results.html))
Capital return continuation (dividends and buybacks) if free cash flow holds through the cycle. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001413447/000141344726000008/nxpi-20251231.htm))
company_overview: NXP Semiconductors N.V. designs and supplies mixed-signal and standard semiconductor solutions across automotive, industrial & IoT, mobile, and communications infrastructure end markets.
Financial statements are presented on a single reportable segment (entity-level performance).
In 2025, NXP reported GAAP operating margin of 24.8% and delivered GAAP operating income of $3.047B on revenue of $12.269B.
current_context: NXP reported Q4 2025 revenue of $3.335B (+7% y/y) with GAAP operating margin of 22.3%. ([globenewswire.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/02/02/3230614/0/en/nxp-semiconductors-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results.html))
Full-year 2025 revenue was $12.269B (-2.7% y/y) and GAAP operating margin was 24.8%. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001413447/000141344726000008/nxpi-20251231.htm))

Company provided Q1 2026 guidance with GAAP tax rate range 0.195 to 0.205 and revenue of $3.050B to $3.250B. ([globenewswire.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/02/02/3230614/0/en/nxp-semiconductors-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results.html))

2025 cash flow from operations was $2.820B, supporting capital return while keeping capex in control. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001413447/000141344726000008/nxpi-20251231.htm))
investment_highlights: Base case assumes revenue re-accelerates modestly after the 2025 down-cycle, supported by demand recovery and ongoing product/portfolio execution. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001413447/000141344726000008/nxpi-20251231.htm))

EBIT margin improves gradually from 2025 levels toward a normalized mid-to-high 20% range as revenue mix stabilizes and cost discipline continues. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001413447/000141344726000008/nxpi-20251231.htm))
D&A and capex are modeled as steady operating ratios consistent with 2023–2025 cash flow patterns. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001413447/000141344726000008/nxpi-20251231.htm))
Working capital intensity is assumed to remain positive but closer to 2024–2025 averages rather than the unusually low 2023 level (base-case NWC% sales).
Terminal value uses conservative long-run growth to reflect semiconductor industry maturity risk (not an aggressive AI-duration assumption).
key_risks: Semiconductor end-demand deterioration or prolonged inventory digestion causing revenue downside vs base-case growth.

Margin pressure from mix shifts, pricing competition, or cost inflation (especially if utilization remains weak). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001413447/000141344726000008/nxpi-20251231.htm))

Geopolitical/trade restrictions and supply-chain disruptions affecting customer demand and manufacturing continuity. ([globenewswire.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/02/02/3230614/0/en/nxp-semiconductors-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results.html))
